episodes.197830: Strong wind convergence enhanced a trough throughout the day to give enhanced rainfall over the American Samoa islands. On December 19th, WSO Pago Pago recorded 2.08 inches of rainfall throughout the day.
episodes.198554: Heavy rain led to river flooding on the White River at Augusta from mid to late December.

events.narrative: A house in the village of Leone was flooded due to heavy rainfall. There were no injuries, but water covered the entire first floor of the house. The owner of the house called WSO Pago Pago in the early evening hours. Estimated rainfall that day through 6 PM for Leone is 2 inches.
The White River at Augusta experienced minor river flooding in late December with the river flooding continuing into early January at which the crest occurred in early January.
